const canvas = document.getElementById('game'); const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); const loader = document.getElementById('loader'); // Настройки игры и магазина let state = 'MENU'; let coins = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('cat_moto_coins')) || 0; let unlocked = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('cat_moto_unlocked')) || ['1000197244.png']; let currentSkin = localStorage.getItem('cat_moto_skin') || '1000197244.png'; const SKINS = [ { id: '1000197244.png', name: 'РЫЖИЙ', price: 0 }, { id: '1000197245.png', name: 'КОСМО', price: 10000 }, { id: '1000197248.png', name: 'МИЛАШКА', price: 2200 }, { id: '1000197247.png', name: 'ХЕЛЛОУИН', price: 25000 } ]; let assets = {}; let roadY = 0; let obstacles = []; let player = { lane: 1, x: 0, animX: 0, targetX: 0 }; let score = 0; function init() { canvas.width = window.innerWidth; canvas.height = window.innerHeight; let loaded = 0; const total = Object.keys(IMAGES_DATA).length; for (let key in IMAGES_DATA) { assets[key] = new Image(); assets[key].src = IMAGES_DATA[key]; assets[key].onload = () => { if (++loaded === total) { loader.style.display = 'none'; requestAnimationFrame(loop); } }; } } function resetGame() { score = 0; obstacles = []; player.lane = 1; player.targetX = (player.lane * (canvas.width / 3)) + (canvas.width / 6) - 75; player.animX = player.targetX; state = 'GAME'; } canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { const tx = e.touches[0].clientX; const ty = e.touches[0].clientY; if (state === 'MENU') { // Кнопка Играть if (ty > canvas.height/2 - 60 && ty < canvas.height/2 + 20) resetGame(); // Кнопка Магазин if (ty > canvas.height/2 + 40 && ty < canvas.height/2 + 120) state = 'STORE'; } else if (state === 'STORE') { if (ty > canvas.height - 100) state = 'MENU'; SKINS.forEach((s, i) => { let bY = 140 + i * 95; if (ty > bY && ty < bY + 80) { if (unlocked.includes(s.id)) { currentSkin = s.id; localStorage.setItem('cat_moto_skin', currentSkin); } else if (coins >= s.price) { coins -= s.price; unlocked.push(s.id); currentSkin = s.id; localStorage.setItem('cat_moto_coins', coins); localStorage.setItem('cat_moto_unlocked', JSON.stringify(unlocked)); localStorage.setItem('cat_moto_skin', currentSkin); } } }); } else if (state === 'GAME') { if (tx < canvas.width / 2) { if (player.lane > 0) player.lane--; } else { if (player.lane < 2) player.lane++; } player.targetX = (player.lane * (canvas.width / 3)) + (canvas.width / 6) - 75; } else if (state === 'OVER') { state = 'MENU'; } }); function loop() { ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); if (state === 'MENU') { ctx.drawImage(assets['1000197260.png'], 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); ctx.fillStyle = "white"; ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.font = "bold 40px Arial"; ctx.fillText("CAT MOTO", canvas.width/2, 100); ctx.font = "20px Arial"; ctx.fillText("БАЛАНС: " + coins, canvas.width/2, 140); ctx.fillStyle = "#4CAF50"; ctx.fillRect(canvas.width/2 - 110, canvas.height/2 - 60, 220, 80); ctx.fillStyle = "white"; ctx.font = "bold 25px Arial"; ctx.fillText("ИГРАТЬ", canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 - 10); ctx.fillStyle = "#FF9800"; ctx.fillRect(canvas.width/2 - 110, canvas.height/2 + 40, 220, 80); ctx.fillStyle = "white"; ctx.fillText("МАГАЗИН", canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 + 90); } if (state === 'STORE') { ctx.fillStyle = "#111"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); ctx.fillStyle = "white"; ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.font = "bold 30px Arial"; ctx.fillText("МАГАЗИН", canvas.width/2, 60); ctx.font = "20px Arial"; ctx.fillText("МОНЕТЫ: " + coins, canvas.width/2, 100); SKINS.forEach((s, i) => { let bY = 140 + i * 95; let isOwned = unlocked.includes(s.id); let isSel = currentSkin === s.id; ctx.fillStyle = isSel ? "#4CAF50" : (isOwned ? "#2196F3" : "#f44336"); ctx.fillRect(20, bY, canvas.width - 40, 80); ctx.fillStyle = "white"; let txt = isOwned ? (isSel ? "ВЫБРАНО" : s.name) : s.name + " - " + s.price; ctx.fillText(txt, canvas.width/2, bY + 48); }); ctx.fillStyle = "#555"; ctx.fillRect(20, canvas.height - 90, canvas.width - 40, 70); ctx.fillStyle = "white"; ctx.fillText("НАЗАД", canvas.width/2, canvas.height - 48); } if (state === 'GAME') { // БЕСШОВНАЯ ДОРОГА const speed = 16; roadY = (roadY + speed) % canvas.height; ctx.drawImage(assets['1000197259.png'], 0, roadY, canvas.width, canvas.height + 3); ctx.drawImage(assets['1000197259.png'], 0, roadY - canvas.height, canvas.width, canvas.height + 3); // ИГРОК (ТОЧНАЯ НАРЕЗКА КОРПУСА) player.animX += (player.targetX - player.animX) * 0.15; let img = assets[currentSkin]; let sw = img.width / 5; // Кадр наклона: 0 - лево, 2 - центр, 4 - право let frame = (player.targetX - player.animX < -15) ? 0 : (player.targetX - player.animX > 15 ? 4 : 2); ctx.drawImage(img, frame * sw, 0, sw, img.height, player.animX, canvas.height - 250, 160, 160); // ПРЕПЯТСТВИЯ if (Math.random() < 0.025) { obstacles.push({ lane: Math.floor(Math.random() * 3), y: -100, type: Math.random() > 0.3 ? 'coin' : 'spike' }); } for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { let o = obstacles[i]; o.y += speed - 2; let ox = (o.lane * (canvas.width / 3)) + (canvas.width / 6) - 55; if (o.type === 'coin') { ctx.drawImage(assets['1000197254.png'], 60, 740, 130, 130, ox, o.y, 110, 110); } else { ctx.drawImage(assets['1000197254.png'], 490, 750, 160, 120, ox, o.y, 110, 90); } // КОЛЛИЗИЯ if (o.y > canvas.height - 260 && o.y < canvas.height - 110 && o.lane === player.lane) { if (o.type === 'spike') { state = 'OVER'; localStorage.setItem('cat_moto_coins', coins); } else { coins += 500; // Бонус 500 для теста (потом поменяй на 1) obstacles.splice(i, 1); } } if (o.y > canvas.height) obstacles.splice(i, 1); } score++; ctx.fillStyle = "white"; ctx.font = "24px Arial"; ctx.textAlign = "left"; ctx.fillText("ОЧКИ: " + score, 20, 45); ctx.fillText("МОНЕТЫ: " + coins, 20, 85); } if (state === 'OVER') { ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.85)"; ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height); ctx.fillStyle = "white"; ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.font = "bold 50px Arial"; ctx.fillText("GAME OVER", canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2); ctx.font = "24px Arial"; ctx.fillText("НАЖМИ ДЛЯ ВЫХОДА", canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 + 70); } requestAnimationFrame(loop); } init();
